messages.author: 171793e5bd0cb49f
messages.subject: [CorpLing with R] Column alignment
parts:
Hello R-ists,

Does anyone know of a way to specify the alignment (right, left,
center, etc.) of individual columns in a data frame printed to
screen?

I've loaded a data frame with read.table() and then pulled out and put
together a few individual columns from that data frame with
data.frame(), and then used print() to print them to screen. The
function print() takes the argument "right=T", which controls all
columns. But, if possible, I'd like to have the first column be right-
aligned, the second center-aligned, and the third left-aligned when it
prints to screen in the console. (I know that this can easily be done
in a spreadsheet, but how about in the R console itself?)

Thanks for your time and help. Still loving R. Earl Brown
